duration: 11 Saturdays, 9 a.m. to noon. Spring 2027 is listed as Jan 23 to Apr 10, with no session Mar 27.
name: Saturday Morning Physics
what_you_do: Go to a free series of 11 Saturday morning talks and tours on modern physics. Topics include particle physics and quantum computing. You do not need a science background.
who_can_apply: High school students in public, private or parochial schools, and home-schooled students with high school standing. Students attend in person. A physics course and two years of algebra help but are not required. A unique email address is required.
deadline_text: Spring 2027 applications open Nov 9, 2026 and close Dec 4, 2026. You hear back by Dec 18, 2026.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online form on the program page. You need a statement and a letter from a teacher. Questions: saturdaymorningphysics@fnal.gov.
notes: Lectures are at Wilson Hall in Batavia. Some lectures may be off-site. You cannot defer if you are accepted, so apply only if you can come in Spring 2027.
